enumeration_note: One VWAP-as-S/R confluence-retest skeleton taught in both directions (long above VWAP, short below) and across anchor periods (session/weekly/monthly) with two compatible confirmation mechanics (immediate limit vs candlestick-close). Long and short are directional applications of the same non-contradictory skeleton, not opposition, so enumerated as one strategy with variants.

coaching_notes: we're only using the vop as an additional tool for Confluence it should not be used just by itself
you should treat this level as an area not a literal number
more often than not price goes through the vop line faking you out or making you think that it won't hold but time and time again it actually ends up respecting it
the momentum is currently bullish so you want to wait for it to change course first instead of immediately entering at the retest
higher time frame levels are more significant and the same thing applies to our vwap
I highly suggest everyone gives this a go for themselves
element_inventory: Directional trend gate: price above VWAP => long-only (bullish); price below VWAP => short-only (bearish)
VWAP used as a support/resistance level/zone (treated as an area, not an exact number)
Confluence requirement: VWAP must line up with at least one additional level (horizontal S/R, 0.5 Fibonacci, or a broken level that flips)
Entry on retest of the VWAP-aligned confluence area
Candlestick-confirmation entry: enter at the candle close after a bullish hammer (long) or a sweep/long-wick / lower-low (short)
Immediate limit-order entry at the confluence area (alternative to waiting for a candlestick pattern)
Long stop placed below the VWAP / swing low; short stop placed just above the swept swing highs
Target the next support/resistance levels in the trade direction
Anchor-period variant: session (default) / weekly / monthly VWAP
Disable the VWAP upper and lower bands (keep only the middle VWAP line)
Multi-VWAP overlay: run session VWAP together with monthly VWAP (differentiate by size/color)
Short-specific entry: on retest of the swing low and fair value gap after a proper lower low forms
strategies.entry_summary: Trade in the direction VWAP dictates (long when price is above VWAP = bullish, short when below = bearish). Identify a support/resistance level that coincides with the VWAP (treated as an area, not an exact number) plus additional confluence (a horizontal level, the 0.5 Fibonacci, or a broken resistance-turned-support). Wait for price to retrace/retest that confluence area, then either enter immediately with a limit order at the area OR wait for a candlestick pattern to confirm (bullish hammer for longs; a sweep through equal highs/lows with a long wick, or a fresh lower-low/lower-high, for shorts) and enter at the candle close.
strategies.exit_summary: Stop just beyond the level/swing (below the VWAP or swing low for longs; above the swept highs for shorts). Target the next support/resistance levels in the trade direction for a favorable risk-to-reward.
